"Lucky" is a song by the American singer Halsey from her fifth studio album, The Great Impersonator (2024).
Columbia Records released it as the album's lead single on July 26, 2024.
It interpolates the Britney Spears song of the same name (2000) in its chorus and the Monica song "Angel of Mine" (1998) in its production.
Badlands (stylized in all caps) is the debut studio album by American singer Halsey.
It was released on August 28, 2015 through Astralwerks.
Musically, Badlands is an electropop, alternative pop, dark pop, and synth-pop record featuring industrial undertones.
John Halsey (born 23 February 1945) is an English rock drummer, best known for his appearance in the television film All You Need is Cash (1978) as Barrington Womble ("Barry Wom") of The Rutles.
